name: protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit beta

function.text: PRKACB encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit beta. Annotated molecular activities include cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and protein phosphorylation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cardioacrofacial dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: PRKACB encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit beta. It mediates cAMP-dependent signaling triggered by receptor binding to GPCRs. PKA activation regulates diverse cellular processes such as cell proliferation, the cell cycle, differentiation and regulation of microtubule dynamics, chromatin condensation and decondensation, nuclear envelope disassembly and reassembly, as well as regulation of intracellular transport mechanisms and ion flux. It regulates the abundance of compartmentalized pools of its regulatory subunits through phosphorylation of PJA2 which binds and ubiquitinates these subunits, leading to their subsequent proteolysis.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with cardioacrofacial dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PRKACB have been reported in extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
